title: Assemble chase UI and reviewed approval fixes; progression conflict held
public_pr_body:
Joins the existing settings/approval/customer-claim cards, live page wiring and #153/#154 approval and atomic-proposal checks on Claude's chase base. Includes current progression helper and wording tests. No docs/ files or SQL application.

HOLD: the inherited chase-steps test expects a firm reminder after a final reminder was already sent, whereas current #108/#119 progression refuses to go backwards. Both assertions are preserved; the focused suite therefore exposes a conflict rather than weakening tests. Resolve the intended progression before release.

Exact-text approval tests and snapshot invalidation are retained. Original card callback assertions now also check the exact reviewed subject/body required by the new callback contract. Initial 94 focused cases and 34 additional progression/wording cases passed separately; combined focused run exposes the inherited progression conflict. Full suite and tsc/lint are running. SQL fixture/rollback tests are included but NOT executed because this task prohibits applying proposals. No Ready label, merge or deployment.

## AS progression resolution
Full head 474a90f63c4625cd29a8253343cd0899aa28f1cc corrects the obsolete test fixture without changing production behaviour. Assumption, supported by existing #119 tests: reminders progress forward and must never fall back after final. The original highest-eligible-unsent requirement is retained with a friendly-sent/firm-due case, plus explicit final-sent refusal and firm-to-final progression. Focused run: 43 passed, zero failed or skipped. Previous progression HOLD above is superseded by this result; database/runtime holds remain.
